items.question: How is desire characterized in relation to ignorance within this teaching?
premises: Desire is the subject being characterized.
Desire is thus declared in this context.
Desire is regarded as connected with ignorance.
items.inference: Desire is declared and regarded as being affected or consumed by ignorance.
uncertainties: The exact analysis of ajñānadardham is unclear; it is read here as related to ajñāna-dagdham (burnt by ignorance).
